name: Níðhöggr
body:
NÍÐHÖGGR
CR 25/MR 10

This skeletal dragon grips corpses in its claws, taking huge, slurping bites out of the meals.

XP 1,638,400
CE Gargantuan unique dragon (mythic)
Init +12M; Senses blindsight 60 ft., darkvision 120 ft., low-light vision, deathwatch, x-ray vision; Perception +35
Aura entropy (10 ft., 2d6 negative energy), frightful presence (330 ft., DC 30)

DEFENSE

AC 50, touch 4, flat-footed 50 (–2 Dex, +46 natural, –4 size)
hp 545 (27d12+370); fast healing 5
Fort +25, Ref +13, Will +22
Defensive Abilities dragon blood (2d6 negative energy), fortification (50%); DR 20/epic and magic; Immune dragon traits, death effects, negative energy, paralysis, poison, sleep; SR 36

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft., fly 100 ft. (average), burrow 40 ft.
Melee bite +39 (4d6+24/18–20 plus poison and grab), 2 claws +39 (2d8+16/19–20 plus poison and grab), 2 wings +37 (2d6+7), tail slap +37 (2d8+26)
Space 20 ft.; Reach 15 ft. (20 ft. with bite)
Special Attacks breath weapon (60-ft. cone, 22d10 negative energy damage, Reflex DC 33 half, usable every 1d4 rounds), crush, degrading entropy, dragon fury (2d6 negative energy), lingering breath (4d6 negative energy, 10 rounds), mythic power (10/day, surge +1d12), plant atrophy, poison, recalled blessing, swallow whole (2d6 bludgeoning and 2d6 negative energy damage, AC 28, 51 hp), tail sweep (DC 32, 2d6+25)
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 27th; concentration +34)

At will—antilife shell, death knell (DC 18), detect magic, inflict critical wounds (DC 20), sands of time (DC 19)

Oracle Spells Known (caster level 17th; concentration +24)

8th (4)—death clutch (DC 25), mass inflict critical wounds (DC 25)
7th (7)—destruction (DC 24), mass inflict serious wounds (DC 24), symbol of weakness (DC 24)
6th (7)—antilife shell, greater curse terrain, harm (DC 23)
5th (7)—greater command M (DC 22), greater contagion (DC 22), mass inflict light wounds (DC 22), slay living (DC 22)
4th (7)—curse terrain, giant vermin, inflict critical wounds (DC 21), lesser spellcrash (DC 21)
3rd (8)—bestow curse (DC 20), blindness/deafness M (DC 20), contagion M (DC 20), inflict serious wounds (DC 20)
2nd (8)—disfiguring touch M, inflict moderate wounds (DC 19), lesser curse terrain, shatter, spiritual weapon
1st (8)—bane M (DC 18), entropic shield M, hairline fractures (DC 18), inflict light wounds (DC 18), ray of sickening

STATISTICS

Str 43, Dex 6, Con 31, Int 5, Wis 19, Cha 23
Base Atk +27; CMB +47 (+51 grapple); CMD 55 (59 vs. trip)
Feats Cleave, Critical Focus, Greater Vital Strike, Improved Critical (bite), Improved Critical (claws), Improved Initiative, Improved Iron Will, Improved Vital Strike, Iron Will, Multiattack, Power Attack, Quicken Spell, Staggering Critical, Vital Strike
Skills Appraise +35, Bluff +37, Diplomacy +37, Fly +14, Intimidate +37, Knowledge (arcana) +35, Knowledge (history) +35, Perception +35, Sense Motive +35, Spellcraft +35, Stealth +16
Languages Abyssal, Common, Draconic, Dwarven, Giant, Orc
SQ dragon cantrips, mythic spellcasting

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Degrading Entropy (Su)

The negative energy created by the Níðhöggr’s blood, breath, and aura are drawn from entropy. The negative energy does not heal undead, but nor does it damage them. The negative energy also damages objects and constructs, though only at half damage.

Entropy Aura (Su)

Níðhöggr is surrounded by an aura of entropy due to its connection to the end of all things. All creatures within 10 feet take 2d6 points of negative energy damage at the beginning of the dragon’s turn.

Plant Entropy (Su)

Níðhöggr can use their breath to destroy all plant life at a range of 100 feet, affecting a 55-foot-radius area.

The all magically created and nonmagical plant material in the area, including wooden structures is turned to loamy dirt. Any plant creature in the area takes 20d8 points of damage on the first round.

Poison (Ex)

Bite—injury; save Fort DC 33; frequency 1/round for 10 rounds; effect 1d4 Con drain and 1d4 Str drain; cure 2 consecutive saves.

ECOLOGY

Environment ancient forests
Organization solitary
Treasure triple

Níðhöggrs are ancient beings corrupted by horrible magics to destroy all that is natural. Their endless hunger is never satiated by the corpses they feast on; when they cannot find dead bodies, they resort to chewing on trees, destroying them at the root.

Where a níðhöggr burrows, forests sour, roots twist into claws, rivers run bitter, and old blessings become brittle things.

It ruins strength, spoils healing, and withers green life.
